name: mod-turn-fold
description: Folds each finished turn under its prompt to one summary line (tools, file changes, skills, agents), keeping the final reply, and folds each finished tool row to one line. A click unfolds either in place

fold_turns.title: Fold finished turns
fold_turns.description: Each finished turn starts folded to one summary line under its prompt. Off, turns start open and the line folds them

fold_tools.title: Fold tool rows
fold_tools.description: Each finished tool row is one line with its own toggle. Off, tool rows draw as Claude Code draws them

timestamps.title: Show times
timestamps.description: Each prompt shows when you sent it, and each tool line when it started and how long it took. Off, rows show no times

expand_live.title: Show the latest turn in full
expand_live.description: The latest turn shows every tool row and result as Claude Code draws them, and folds when your next prompt starts. Off, finished tool calls fold right away

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
